name: Electronic signature
description: Sends PDFs attached to deals for electronic signature in Clicksign and tracks the status through webhooks. No legal validity of its own: the validity is the provider's.
legalNotice: Aphel has no legal validity of its own for signatures: the validity is Clicksign's, which collects the signatures and the evidence.

environment.label: Environment
environment.help: Sandbox for testing; production for real signatures

access_token.label: Clicksign access token
access_token.help: Generated in Settings → API in Clicksign; stored encrypted and never shown

webhook_secret.label: Webhook HMAC secret
webhook_secret.help: HMAC SHA256 key of the webhook registered in Clicksign (Content-Hmac header)

attach_signed_document.label: Attach the signed PDF to the deal
attach_signed_document.help: When completed, downloads the signed document and attaches it to the deal

settingsPanel.stepToken: In Clicksign, generate an API access token and paste it into "Access token".
settingsPanel.stepWebhook: Register a webhook in Clicksign pointing to the address below.
settingsPanel.stepSecret: Copy the webhook HMAC SHA256 key into "Webhook HMAC secret".
settingsPanel.enableFirst: Enable the module to see the webhook address.

deal.title: Signatures
deal.description: Send PDFs attached to this deal (such as generated proposals) for electronic signature and track the status.
deal.notConfigured: Configure the Clicksign access token in the module settings to send documents.
deal.sandbox: Test environment (sandbox): signatures have no real effect.
deal.emptyDescription: Choose an attached PDF and the signers to send.

confirmCancel.title: Cancel signature request?
confirmCancel.description: "{{name}}" will be cancelled in Clicksign and the signers will no longer be able to sign.

dialog.title: Send for signature
dialog.description: The PDF and the signers' data (name and email) will be sent to Clicksign.
dialog.noPdf: No PDF attached to this deal. Attach a file or generate a proposal first.
dialog.messagePlaceholder: Message sent to the signers with the invitation
dialog.privacy: Each signer gets the invitation by email and confirms their identity with a code sent to the email.

timeline.signed_file_attached: Signed PDF attached to the deal

errors.esign_file_not_attached: The file is not attached to this deal
errors.esign_file_too_large: The PDF is larger than 20 MB
errors.permission_denied: You are not allowed to do this
